messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: High-severity — repeated container restarts on us-west1-gpu-42. Symptom: GPU OOMs during prefill for long-context requests, causing streaming failures for a subset of customers. Auto-escalate to oncall.
sre-oncall: Acknowledged. I'm on it. Can someone grab the kernel/runtime logs and allocate a pager window?
runtime-eng: I see repeated:
```
CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY: failed to allocate 1.2GiB (device 0)
stack: runtime::kv_cache_prefill -> attention_prefetch -> cudaMalloc
container restart triggered by OOM watchdog
```
Looks like prefill path is attempting to allocate large KV caches for >64k token contexts.
ml-infra: We're seeing a spike in requests with very large contexts from a small group of tenants (long-document ingestion). Rate for those requests jumped 4x in last 3m.
sre-oncall: Immediate mitigations — please try (a) enable prefill throttling on node, (b) temporarily disable KV prefetch for affected model variant, (c) taint & drain noisy pod(s). Who can run the commands?
runtime-eng: Running throttles now. Commands I'm applying on node us-west1-gpu-42:
```
kubectl annotate node us-west1-gpu-42 maintenance=true --overwrite
kubectl cordon us-west1-gpu-42
kubectl drain us-west1-gpu-42 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
redwoodctl runtime set-config --model rdx-70b --kv-prefetch=false --selector node=us-west1-gpu-42
```
Applying a config toggle to disable kv-prefetch for this pool.
customer-success: Heads up — CS, please prepare a short note for impacted accounts. Which customers affected and what's ETA?
sre-oncall: Quick status: drained the noisy pod, restarted other replicas. Errors dropped but a few containers still restart on prefill when they hit huge contexts. Last crash trace shows mixed OOM + "CUDA kernel launch timed out" on some attempts.
ops-lead: Can we route long-context requests temporarily to Dedicated pool or CPU fallback? We should avoid customer-facing errors.
runtime-eng: We pushed a fast fallback: requests with context_length > 32k are being routed to rdx-70b-cpu-fallback and we enabled streaming partial responses. This reduces peak GPU allocation. Only doing this for tenants with recent large-context spikes.
customer-success: Initial impact estimate: ~3 customers (enterprise doc-ingest) saw ~18-25% error rates on ingestion pipelines over the last 20m. They're now rerouted; notify in 10m with update.
devexp: Noted — adjusting SDK client retry/backoff recommended. Pushing a client-side advisory for long requests: reduce max_prefetch or use chunked uploads.
ml-infra: Short-term patch idea: add prefill cap at runtime that trims prefills to last 32k tokens and optionally emits a warn metric. Will prepare a PR for hotpatch.
eng-mgr: Thanks. SRE, runtime, MLInfra — please coordinate a short post-incident checklist: root cause, why prefetch disabled wasn't enough, regression windows, and owner for a long-term fix (KV compaction, prefill caps, better eviction).
sre-oncall: Current status (1769804520): live mitigation in place, error rate for affected customers down to ~2-4%. No broader customer impact. We're keeping node cordoned until evening rotation. Postmortem owners assigned: runtime-eng (root cause), ml-infra (preventative), devexp (client guidance), cs (customer comm).
eng-mgr: Good work — ops-lead, schedule a follow-up runbook update this week. I'll join the postmortem tomorrow.
incident-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: mitigation implemented, severity reduced to P2. Pager cleared for oncall rotation. Follow-ups: hotpatch PR (#1428), runbook update, targeted customer emails.
__notes: Follow-up: keep messages compact to mimic Slack thread style. This file contains root + replies in chronological order.
